title: ASK GOD TO ALIGN YOUR DESIRES WITH HIS, TODAY
text: Lift your hands wherever you are. Lift your hands and just worship him for a moment. Father, we thank you. We thank you, Lord. You are worthy of all praise, worthy of all adoration. We bless your name this morning. We bless your name. Be seated. Be seated in the presence of the Lord. I want you to open your Bible this morning. Keep your hands lifted. Keep your spirit open because what God is about to do in this place, in your heart, in your mind, in your understanding is not ordinary. I have learned beloved that the greatest danger a man can face is not poverty. It is not sickness. It is not even the arrows of the enemy. The greatest danger a man can face is to want the wrong things and want them desperately to be passionate in the wrong direction. To be fed for something that God never ordained for your life. And yet many of us wake up every single morning burning burning with desires. Burning with ambitions burning with longings. And we have never paused long enough to ask, "Lord, did you put this in me? Is this fire from heaven or is it fire I gathered from the altars of this world?" Turn with me to the book of Psalms 37 and:e4. Let's read it together. The scripture says, "Delight yourself also in the Lord and he shall give you the desires of your heart." Now, most people read that verse and they run straight to the second part. They say, "God will give me the desires of my heart and they treat God like a vending machine. You put in a prayer, you pull out a blessing. But the wisdom of God is hidden in the first clause. Delight yourself in the Lord. That word delight in the Hebrew is times anag times. It means to be soft, to be pliable, to find your greatest pleasure, your deepest satisfaction, your most complete joy in God and in God alone. The implication is staggering. When you truly delight in God, when he becomes the object of your greatest affection, something supernatural begins to happen. your desires begin to change. They begin to align. They begin to look like his desires. Because you cannot truly commune with someone without beginning to look like them, sound like them, want what they want. This is the mystery of alignment. And alignment, beloved, is not a small thing. Alignment is everything. In the kingdom of God, the difference between a blessed life and a frustrated life is not talent. It is not even hard work. Though hard work has its place, the difference is alignment. A man who is aligned with divine purpose moves with the current of heaven behind him. But a man who is pursuing his own desires, his own agendas, even if he's gifted, even if he's working hard, he's swimming upstream against the very will of the God who made him. And the tragedy is that many of them are praying, many of them are fasting, many of them are in church every Sunday, but they are religious and misaligned. And religion without alignment produces frustration, not fruitfulness. I want to talk to somebody this morning who has been working hard. You have been faithful. You have been consistent. But there is this quiet sense in your spirit, something doesn't feel right. Something isn't connecting. You do not lack effort. You do not lack intelligence but there is a persistent feeling that you are building something and heaven is not recognizing the structure. I have come to tell you that what you need is not more effort. What you need is alignment. What you need is for the desires of your heart to be baptized in the will of God. Now let me show you something. In the book of Proverbs 19:21 the scripture says many are the plans in a person's heart but it is the Lord's purpose that prevails. many plans, many desires, many visions, many 5-year plans, many business models, many relationship expectations. But it is God's purpose, singular, intentional, irrevocable. It is God's purpose that prevails. That word prevails does not just mean it comes last. It means it stands firm. It means it endures. Everything else around it rises and falls, shifts and changes, but God's purpose stands. And the question I want to ask you today is, have you built your life around what prevails? Have you anchored your desires to the thing that stands? Because there are two kinds of desires. There are earthly desires. Desires that are born from what you have seen, what you have experienced, what the world has told you success looks like. And there are heavenborn desires. desires that God himself deposits in your spirit like seeds, like blueprints, like divine assignments. And the tragedy is that we are often so loud, so busy, so distracted by the earthly desires that we cannot hear the still small voice of heaven whispering what he actually put us here to do. I think about the life of King David. Here is a man after God's own heart. What made David different from every other king? What separated him from Saul? Saul had desires too. Saul had ambition. Saul wanted to be great. But Saul's desires were self-referential. They always circled back to himself. His image, his legacy, his reputation. David had desires, too. But David had learned something that Saul never learned. David had learned to bring his desires into the presence of God and let God sift them. That's why the Psalms are what they are. The Psalms are the journal of a man who kept bringing his raw, unfiltered, sometimes confused desires before the Lord and saying, "God, here is what I feel. Here is what I want. Now, Lord, align me, shape me, correct me. Let your will be the final word." And God honored that. God honored that so deeply that he called David a man after his own heart. Not a man who was perfect. David was far from perfect, but a man whose desires kept bending toward heaven. A man who kept returning, keep coming back, keep pressing into the presence of God until what he wanted started looking like what God wanted. That is what I'm praying for you this morning. That is the grace I'm releasing over your life today. That your desires would begin to bend. That the selfish, the shallow, the worldly, the ego-driven desires would fall away like scales from your eyes. And what would be left, what would remain would be the pure, burning, heaven-born desires that God placed in you before the foundations of the world. Turn with me quickly to Jeremiah 29:1. The Lord says, "For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord. Plans to prosper you and not to harm you. Plans to give you hope and a future." I want to establish something here this morning. God has a plan. It is not vague. It is not generic. This is not a mass-produced destiny distributed equally to all 7 billion people on this planet. God has a specific, detailed, personalized, tailor-made plan for your life. He knows your name. He knows your gifts. He knows where you are most effective, most powerful, most fruitful. And that plan involves prospering you. It involves your hope. It involves your future. But here is the tension. Here is where many of us get stuck. We believe God has a plan, but we are not sure our desires match that plan. And rather than surrendering our desires to God, we do something very subtle and very dangerous. We spiritualize our own desires. We pray around them. We present them to God wrapped in religious language. We say, "God, I want this business to succeed for your glory. But if we are honest deep in our hearts, we want it to succeed for our own validation. We want to prove something to someone. We want to silence a voice from our past. We want to arrive at a certain level of comfort or recognition. And we clothe those desires in the garments of ministry, the garments of service. And we think we have sanctified them. But God who searches the heart, who weighs the motives, God is not confused. Romans 8:27 says, "The spirit makes intercession for us according to the will of God." The spirit prays according to the will of God, not according to the will of our flesh. This is why Paul says in Romans 12:2, "Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God's will is, his good, pleasing, and perfect will." The renewing of the mind is the laboratory where desires are transformed. When your mind is renewed by the word of God, when your thought patterns begin to shift from worldly logic to kingdom logic, your desires shift with your thinking, you stop wanting what the world told you to want. You start wanting what God always intended for you to desire. And this this is where breakthrough lives. This is where the supernatural begins to show up. Because when your desires are aligned with God's will, you are no longer fighting heaven to get what you want. You are cooperating with heaven. You are not pushing against the current. You are in the current. And the river of God's grace begins to carry you to places you could never carry yourself. I want to tell you about Isaiah 55:8-9. God says, "For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways. As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways and my thoughts than your thoughts. Now, people use this verse to explain why God doesn't always answer prayers the way we want. And that is true. But there is more here. God is not saying his thoughts are different and there is nothing we can do about it. He's inviting you into the upgrade. He's saying your current thinking is earth level, but I am calling you to heaven level thinking. And when you begin to think heaven level thoughts, you begin to carry heaven level desires. You begin to dream the dreams that angels have been waiting to help you accomplish. Let me speak to the young people this morning. You are in a generation that is drowning in choices. Social media shows you a thousand possible lives every single day. A thousand possible versions of success. A thousand different definitions of a good life. And the enemy uses that noise, that beautiful glittering, seductive noise to drown out the voice of God, to make you so full of other people's visions that there is no room for your own divine assignment. And you end up pursuing what went viral instead of what was ordained. You end up chasing a life that looks impressive on a screen, but feels empty in your chest. This morning, I am asking you to make a decision. I am asking you to do something radical in this hour. Come before God not with your list, not with your requests, not with your demands. Come before God with your open hands and say, "Father, search me. Know me. Show me the desires that are not from you. Show me the ones that are and give me the courage to let go of everything that is not aligned with your purpose for my life." That prayer, beloved, is not a prayer of resignation. It is not a prayer of defeat. It is a prayer of supreme intelligence. It is the prayer of a man or woman who has understood that God's plan for your life is better than anything you could have dreamed up for yourself. His plan is more beautiful, more rewarding, more impactful, more eternal than the best plan you could write on a whiteboard. Look at Matthew 6:33. Jesus says, "But seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be added to you." Seek first, not second, not alongside everything else. first the kingdom, the rule of God, the reign of God, the will of God. Seek that first. And what happens? All these things, all the legitimate needs, all the righteous desires, all the good things, they are added. They are added. You do not have to chase them. You do not have to manipulate circumstances to get them. You do not have to compromise your integrity to acquire them. When you seek first, God adds. And what God adds does not come with sorrow. Proverbs 10:22, the blessing of the Lord makes rich and he adds no sorrow with it. There is a kind of getting that has sorrow attached to it. You wanted it so badly. You cut corners to get it. You went around God to get it. You manipulated someone to get it. And now you have it. But there is this weight, this unease, this constant anxiety that it will be taken from you because something in your spirit knows you reach for it outside of divine order. But what God adds, what comes through alignment, through trust, through surrender, it carries peace. It carries a rightness. It carries the fingerprint of heaven on it. I want to give you one more scripture before we move into this prayer. And it is found in John 15:7. Jesus says, "If you abide in me and my words abide in you, ask whatever you wish and it will be done for you. Ask whatever you wish." That sounds dangerous until you understand the condition. If you abide in him, if his words abide in you, when you are truly abiding, when you are dwelling in Christ, living in Christ, thinking from within Christ, your wishes begin to mirror his wishes. Your will and his will begin to converge. And at that point, the asking is almost effortless because you are not asking for things that are foreign to heaven. You are asking for things that heaven has already been preparing to release. This is the life I'm inviting you into this morning. Not a life of constant striving, constant begging, constant trying to convince God to give you what you want, but a life of such deep communion with God that what you want and what he wants become increasingly one and the same. Before we go into prayer, I want you to do something. I want you to share this message. Share it right now before we pray. Somebody in your contact list, somebody on your social media, somebody needs this word this morning. Somebody woke up this morning confused about their direction, frustrated with their desires, wondering why heaven seems silent. Share this with them. Let the Holy Spirit use this word to find them wherever they are. Do it right now. Share it. Because the word of God is not meant to be hoarded. It is meant to be released like seed into the ground. Now, let us pray. Let us pray like we mean it. Lift your hands. Open your mouth. Father, we thank you. We thank you for the gift of this morning. We thank you that we woke up with breath in our lungs and purpose still in our hearts. We thank you, Lord, that you are a God who aligns, a God who orders, a God who redirects. We bless your name. We worship you, Holy Spirit. Ruakodes, the breath of the living God. Breathe upon every person hearing this word right now. Breathe upon them. Let the stale winds of confusion give way to the fresh wind of your clarity and your purpose. Now, Father, I bring every heart before you this morning. Every man, every woman, every young person who has been running hard but feels like they are running in the wrong direction. Lord, I ask you by the power of the Holy Spirit to interrupt their momentum. Interrupt their momentum in love. Not to break them, but to redirect them. not to shame them but to align them. Let there be a divine interruption in the spirit this morning that produces lasting realignment in the natural. Lord, I come against every desire in the heart of your children that is rooted in ego and not in eternal purpose. I come against every ambition that was planted by the enemy disguised as godly pursuit. I come against every longing that was born from a wound. Every desire to prove something, to avenge something, to compensate for something. I speak healing to those wounds right now in the name of Jesus. And I declare that from healed desires come aligned purposes. And from aligned purposes come supernatural results. Father, we ask you now, we ask you specifically and boldly to do what only you can do. Do surgery on our desires this morning. Search us as David prayed. Search me, oh God, and know my heart. Try me and know my anxious thoughts. See if there is any offensive way in me and lead me in the way everlasting. That is our prayer. Lord, search us, know us, expose what is not aligned. And then Lord, do not just remove it, replace it. Fill the space with your desires. Fill the vacuum with heaven longings. Let us begin to want what you want. Let us begin to hunger for what you hunger for. Let us begin to be moved by what moves your heart. Lord, I pray for the man or woman this morning who has been waiting a long time for breakthrough. Who has prayed and fasted and believed, but the manifestation has not come. Lord, I ask you not in accusation, but in love and inquiry. Reveal to them if there is a misalignment. Reveal to them if what they have been asking for has been the wrong thing or the right thing in the wrong season or the right thing sought in the wrong spirit. And Lord, give them the grace to receive that revelation without offense. Give them the grace to say, "God, not my will but yours be done." For they know, Lord, that your will is always better. I pray for alignment in careers this morning. Lord, there are people who are stuck in vocations that were never ordained by you. They drifted there. They were pressured there. They ended up there by the logic of the world. Lord, speak to them this morning. Ignite in them the desire for their true assignment. And give them the courage to make the transitions that alignment demands, knowing that you, Lord, are the God who provides, the God who opens doors, the God who does not call you without equipping you. I pray for alignment in relationships. Lord, there are people bound by emotional attachments to individuals who are not assigned to their destiny. People who are pouring their hearts into connections that God never ordained. Lord, with the gentleness of a loving father, I ask you to bring clarity. Let every divine relationship be strengthened this morning. Let every misaligned relationship be addressed by the conviction of the Holy Spirit. and let your people have the courage to build according to divine blueprint rather than emotional convenience. I pray for alignment in ministry. Lord, there are people in ministry doing good things, genuinely good things, but not God things. They are building altars you never asked for. They are starting churches you never commissioned. They are writing books you never inspired. Lord, I speak to every minister, every servant, every believer who carries a burden for your house. Align them. Align their gifts with their assignment. Align their passion with their purpose. Align the fire in their belly with the vision in your heart for their life. Now, I want to pray something very specific and very militant. I want to pray against every demonic assignment that operates through misaligned desires in the name of Jesus. I bind every spirit of seduction that has been attaching itself to the desires of God's people. Spirits that dress up wrong things to look like right things. Spirits that make the flesh speak in the language of the spirit. Spirits that produce counterfeit peace around decisions. I bind them in the name that is above every name. The name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, the name before which every knee must bow in heaven, on earth, and under the earth. I bind every spirit of delay that has been operating in the lives of people because they have been pursuing things outside of alignment. I declare that as they return to alignment, delay loses its power. As they return to alignment, the years that the locust has eaten begin to be restored. As they return to alignment, the supernatural grace of acceleration begins to operate in their lives. I speak to every dream that was buried. I speak to every assignment that was set aside because of discouragement, because of disappointment, because of the opinions of others. I declare resurrection this morning in the name of Jesus. What was buried is coming back to life. What was dormant is being activated. What was silence is finding its voice again. I declare over every person hearing this right now, your desires are being refined in this very moment. Like gold in a furnace, like silver in a crucible, the Holy Spirit is passing your desires through the fire of his presence. And everything that is not from him is burning away. And what remains, what comes out on the other side of this prayer is pure. It is God breathed. It is aligned. I declare that you will no longer waste energy, resources, time, and tears on things that were never in God's plan for your life. I declare clarity where there was confusion. I declare focus where there was distraction. I declare divine direction where there was aimless wandering. You are not a wanderer, you are a scent one. You are not a person of chance. You are a person of divine appointment. And from this morning, you will move with the awareness that every step you take is being ordered by the Lord. Psalm 37-23. The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord. And he delights in his way. The Lord delights in your way, not tolerates it, not watches it with a concerned eye. He delights. He takes pleasure. He's invested in the unfolding of your life. And when you align your desires with his will, you give him the room to delight fully to open heaven over you to cause every force of creation to cooperate with your assignment. I speak to every mountain of frustration. I speak to every wall of stagnation. I speak to every closed door that has been standing between you and your ordained future. By the word of the Lord and the power of the Holy Spirit, those mountains are being moved. Those walls are coming down. Those doors are being opened. Not by your might, not by your power, but by the spirit of the living God who has decided that your alignment is the catalyst for your acceleration. Father, seal this prayer. Seal this word in every heart. Let it go beyond an emotional experience this morning. Let it go deep into the spirit of every person who has received this message. Let it be like the seed that fell on good ground that it takes root, grows deep, and produces fruit that remains. Fruit that is aligned, fruit that glorifies your name. I declare that the people who have prayed this prayer today will not walk out of this moment the same way they walked in. They will carry a new sensitivity to the voice of God. They will carry a new willingness to let go of desires that are not from heaven. They will carry a new courage to pursue what God has placed in them regardless of what it looks like, regardless of what others say, regardless of the cost. Because the man or woman who is aligned with the will of God is the most dangerous person on this earth to the kingdom of darkness. They cannot be bought. They cannot be diverted. They cannot be confused. They walk with such clarity of purpose, such singleness of heart, such certainty of assignment that every weapon formed against them is dismantled before it can function. That is who you are becoming. That is who you already are in Christ. The seed of divine purpose is in you. The desire of heaven is reaching toward you even as you reach toward it. And the God who began a good work in you is faithful to complete it. Philippians 1:6, he is faithful. He does not abandon what he starts. He does not get tired of aligning you. He does not give up on redirecting you. He's patient. He's persistent. He's committed to your completion. Receive this word. Walk in it. Live in it. Let it be the governing principle of your life from this day forward. Not what do I want, but Lord, what do you want? Not what makes sense to me, but Lord, show me what makes sense in eternity. Not what looks good but Lord what is aligned with your purpose for my life. That shift that one small but enormous shift in the posture of your heart will change everything. Lord we thank you. We thank you for this morning. We thank you for alignment. We thank you for the grace to want the right things. We thank you that you are even now in this moment working in us both to will and to do of your good pleasure. Philippians 2:13. You are walking in us, not waiting for us to be perfect before you walk. You are walking even now, shaping our desires, bending our will, wooing our heart toward yours. We love you, Lord. We trust you and we surrender. We surrender our plans. We surrender our timelines. We surrender our definitions of success. We surrender our carefully constructed blueprints and we receive yours in Jesus name. In the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit. Somebody say amen. Somebody say amen and mean it. This is your morning. This is your realignment. This is your new beginning. Walk in it. God bless you.
